job.job_description:
About the Opportunity
We are hiring GenAI Full Stack Developers for a leading global analytics and AI consulting organization. You build the application layer of enterprise GenAI connecting LLM backends to fast, scalable, user-facing products.

Key Responsibilities

Design scalable microservices handling LLM requests, streaming responses (SSE), and context management
Build robust RESTful/GraphQL APIs in Python/Node.js routing user queries to LLM pipelines
Develop responsive interfaces for GenAI applications — chat UIs, dashboards — in React/Next.js
Ensure low-latency integration between frontends and Python/FastAPI backends running AI models
Deploy AI applications on AWS/Azure/GCP with CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes
Maintain relational and NoSQL databases for interaction logging, user preferences, and LLM response caching

What Makes You a Fit

3–7 years in full-stack or backend development with strong recent focus on integrating AI/LLM capabilities into web apps
Proficiency in Python (FastAPI/Django) and JavaScript/TypeScript (React, Node.js)
Hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud AI services
Notice period: 30 days or less only

Education: Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science or related field

Why This Role
You ship the products users actually touch — real AI features in production, not experiments. Level (Senior Analyst / Senior Manager) is mapped to your experience and depth.
